subject: Operations

findings.subject: Operations
findings.title: No retry-with-backoff policy wraps the database connection/query or the OTLP exporter calls
findings.recommendation: Wrap the DB open/query call with a Polly retry policy (exponential backoff, small retry count) for transient SqlException/NpgsqlException errors.

findings.subject: Operations
findings.title: No circuit breaker protects calls to the database or the OpenTelemetry collector
findings.recommendation: Add a Polly circuit-breaker policy around the DB client (and rely on the OTLP SDK's own built-in export retry/backoff, verifying it's configured) so a degraded dependency doesn't cascade into request failures.

checkResults.subject: Operations
checkResults.reason: A ConnectTimeout is configured per data source, and DB drivers/OTLP exporter use provider-default command/export timeouts.
